title: U-2 approaching the USS Kitty Hawk, 5 August 1963 (carrier trials)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a U-2 in silhouette flying low over the sea toward the edge of an aircraft carrier deck. Captioned "U-2 on the USS Kitty Hawk, 5 August 1963." Chapter 5 text (page 248) describes the first carrier-operations test off San Diego and Kelly Johnson's modifications producing the U-2G.
